messages.author: f06db63329fab1f9
messages.subject: Migration to GCC-4.7
parts:
For anyone who's building from Renjin from source, note that we have just migrated our GCC-Bridge compile from GCC-4.6 to GCC-4.7. If you're building with Vagrant, you can just run

vagrant destroy
vagrant up

For those working on Debian/Ubuntu, you can follow the instructions here:
https://github.com/bedatadriven/renjin/blob/master/BUILDING.md#ubuntu-1404

GCC-4.7 is available on the latest LTS release - Ubuntu 16.04 as well as the now aging Ubuntu 14.04 LTS, so this update should keep us chugging along for awhile. 

I have however removed the now-outdated instructions for building on OS X. If you're developing on OS X, please bootstrap your build using Vagrant (or submit a PR with instructions on how to get GCC-4.7 and the plugin built!)

If you run into any problems building, don't hesitate to open an issue!

Best,
Alex
